title: Highlights of Psalms
description: 150 poems of praise, honesty, sorrow, and trust, written over hundreds of years — words for every emotion we bring to God.

waypoints.title: Israel's Songbook
waypoints.body: The Psalms are Israel's songbook, written by David and others over hundreds of years. Some are joyful praise, some are honest cries of sorrow or fear -- together they give us words for every emotion we bring to God.

waypoints.title: Which Psalm Fits Today?
waypoints.body: Which Psalm sounds most like how you feel today -- happy, worried, thankful, sad? Look one up together.
